title: BCPC
statementMd:
BCPC stands for Byteforces Collegiate Programming Contest, and is the most famous competition in Byteforces.

BCPC is a team competition. Each team is composed by a coach and three contestants. Blenda is the coach of the Bit State University(BSU), and she is very strict selecting the members of her team.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/128e432f6720dd66e0cabad8a1d255b7fb9ebb61.png)

In BSU there are $*n*$ students numbered from 1 to $*n*$. Since all BSU students are infinitely smart, the only important parameters for Blenda are their reading and writing speed. After a careful measuring, Blenda have found that the $*i*$-th student have a **reading** speed equal to $*r*_{*i*}$ (words per minute), and a **writing** speed of $*w*_{*i*}$ (symbols per minute). Since BSU students are very smart, the measured speeds are sometimes very big and Blenda have decided to subtract some constant value $*c*$ from all the values of reading speed and some value $*d*$ from all the values of writing speed. Therefore she considers $*r*_{*i*}' = *r*_{*i*} - *c*$ and $*w*_{*i*}' = *w*_{*i*} - *d*$.

The student $*i*$ is said to *overwhelm* the student $*j*$ if and only if $*r*_{*i*}'·*w*_{*j*}' > *r*_{*j*}'·*w*_{*i*}'$. Blenda doesn’t like fights in teams, so she thinks that a team consisting of three distinct students $*i*, *j*$ and $*k*$ is *good* if $*i*$ overwhelms $*j*$, $*j*$ overwhelms $*k*$, and $*k*$ overwhelms $*i*$. Yes, the relation of overwhelming is not transitive as it often happens in real life.

Since Blenda is busy preparing a training camp in Codeforces, you are given a task to calculate the number of different good teams in BSU. Two teams are considered to be different if there is at least one student that is present in one team but is not present in the other. In other words, two teams are different if the sets of students that form these teams are different.

## Input

In the first line of the input three integers $*n*$, $*c*$ and $*d*$ ($3 ≤ *n* ≤ 345678, 1 ≤ *c*, *d* ≤ 10^{9}$) are written. They denote the number of students Blenda can use to form teams, the value subtracted from all reading speeds and the value subtracted from all writing speeds respectively.

Each of the next $*n*$ lines contains two integers $*r*_{*i*}$ and $*w*_{*i*}$ ($0 < *r*_{*i*}, *w*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}, |*r*_{*i*} - *c*| + |*w*_{*i*} - *d*| > 0$). There are no two students, such that both their reading and writing speeds coincide, i.e. for every $*i* ≠ *j*$ condition $|*r*_{*i*} - *r*_{*j*}| + |*w*_{*i*} - *w*_{*j*}| > 0$ holds.

## Output

Print the number of different teams in BSU, that are good according to Blenda's definition.

## Note

In the first sample the following teams are good: $(*i* = 1, *j* = 2, *k* = 3)$, $(*i* = 2, *j* = 5, *k* = 1)$, $(*i* = 1, *j* = 4, *k* = 3)$, $(*i* = 5, *j* = 1, *k* = 4)$.

Note, that for example the team $(*i* = 3, *j* = 1, *k* = 2)$ is also good, but is considered to be the same as the team $(*i* = 1, *j* = 2, *k* = 3)$.
statementZhMd:
BCPC 是 Byteforces Collegiate Programming Contest 的缩写，也是 Byteforces 中最著名的比赛。

BCPC 是一项团队竞赛。每支队伍由一名教练和三名选手组成。Blenda 是 Bit State University（BSU）的教练，她在挑选队员时非常严格。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/128e432f6720dd66e0cabad8a1d255b7fb9ebb61.png)

BSU 中有 $*n*$ 名学生，编号从 1 到 $*n*$。由于所有 BSU 学生都极其聪明，因此对 Blenda 来说，他们最重要的参数只有阅读速度和书写速度。经过仔细测量，Blenda 发现第 $*i*$ 名学生的**阅读**速度为 $*r*_{*i*}$（每分钟单词数），**书写**速度为 $*w*_{*i*}$（每分钟字符数）。由于 BSU 的学生非常聪明，测得的速度有时会非常大，因此 Blenda 决定从所有阅读速度中减去某个常数 $*c*$，并从所有书写速度中减去某个值 $*d*$。于是她将 $*r*_{*i*}' = *r*_{*i*} - *c*$ 和 $*w*_{*i*}' = *w*_{*i*} - *d*$ 作为新的速度。

当且仅当 $*r*_{*i*}'·*w*_{*j*}' > *r*_{*j*}'·*w*_{*i*}'$ 时，称学生 $*i*$ *压倒*学生 $*j*$。Blenda 不喜欢队伍中发生争斗，因此她认为由三个不同的学生 $*i*$、$*j*$ 和 $*k*$ 组成的队伍是*优秀的*，当且仅当 $*i*$ 压倒 $*j*$，$*j*$ 压倒 $*k*$，并且 $*k*$ 压倒 $*i*$。是的，压倒关系并不具有传递性，这在现实生活中也很常见。

由于 Blenda 正忙于准备 Codeforces 训练营，现在请你计算 BSU 中不同优秀队伍的数量。如果至少有一名学生出现在其中一支队伍中而没有出现在另一支队伍中，则认为两支队伍不同。换句话说，如果组成两支队伍的学生集合不同，则这两支队伍不同。

## 输入格式

输入第一行包含三个整数 $*n*$、$*c*$ 和 $*d*$（$3 ≤ *n* ≤ 345678, 1 ≤ *c*、$*d*$ ≤ 10^{9}$），分别表示 Blenda 可以用来组队的学生数量、从所有阅读速度中减去的值，以及从所有书写速度中减去的值。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，第 $*i*$ 行包含两个整数 $*r*_{*i*}$ 和 $*w*_{*i*}$（$0 < *r*_{*i*}, *w*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}, |*r*_{*i*} - *c*| + |*w*_{*i*} - *d*| > 0$）。不存在两个阅读速度和书写速度都相同的学生，即对于任意 $*i* ≠ *j*$，条件 $|*r*_{*i*} - *r*_{*j*}| + |*w*_{*i*} - *w*_{*j*}| > 0$ 均成立。

## 输出格式

输出 BSU 中符合 Blenda 定义的优秀队伍数量。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，以下队伍是优秀的：$(*i* = 1, *j* = 2, *k* = 3)$、$(*i* = 2, *j* = 5, *k* = 1)$、$(*i* = 1, *j* = 4, *k* = 3)$、$(*i* = 5, *j* = 1, *k* = 4)$。

注意，例如队伍 $(*i* = 3, *j* = 1, *k* = 2)$ 也满足优秀队伍的条件，但它与队伍 $(*i* = 1, *j* = 2, *k* = 3)$ 被视为同一支队伍。
